dispositions.rationale: Paradigm genuine-meta bedrock: pluralism cannot be non-circularly defeated, and the library does not try. The face grants the plurality whole, locates the universal premise (no live framework treats suffering as good or irrelevant — a system that shrugs at suffering is an aesthetic, not an ethics), and relocates the real dispute to tolerance-weighting. The tolerance-weighing pluralist — who ranks autonomy or perfectionist goods above suffering-minimization — persists coherent and unbound; but pluralism granted in full hands them no framework that licenses creating certain suffering. Answered, unbound, does no work.

dispositions.rationale: Same structure as pluralism: anti-theory is bedrock, not defeated. The face grants particularism in full — reasons live in contexts, no rule floats above the cases — and shows the granted premise reaches nothing: a birth into congenital agony IS a case, the most particular datum there is, and case-by-case perception condemns it without any rule. The particularist qua anti-theorist persists untouched; nothing refutes particularism itself. The premise stands; it does no work.

dispositions.rationale: The objection as catalogued is the conflation: it swaps the button's stipulated content (instantaneous, painless, universal cessation) for a scene of mass murder, then recoils at the violence it added. That move is a clean category error — the horror attaches to features the experiment holds constant precisely to isolate the existence question. It falls. NODE-INDIVIDUATION NOTE: the purified Moorean retreat ('even painless cessation is bad; existence is intrinsically good, axiomatically') is a DIFFERENT objection — it exits this node and re-forms as the intrinsic-value-of-existence position, which the library handles in the asymmetry cluster and openly flags under the asymmetry-contingency honest residual. The sophisticate archetype variant exists to route that retreat in play. What is routed here is the conflation; the retreat is not defeated here and is not claimed to be.

dispositions.rationale: Category error, cleanly: it offers memetic fitness (can the view reproduce its believers?) as a test of truth (is the view correct?), and the two never touch — heliocentrism nearly lost all its carriers and the Earth kept orbiting the Sun. No bedrock persists: 'replication-fitness bears on truth' is not a position anyone reflexively stakes, and pressed, it invalidates every persecuted-true idea equally. Cannot be coherently maintained once the two questions are separated.
